item.title: Witkoff and Kushner visit Ukraine for peace talks
item.description: President Trump's envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Kyiv on Sunday for diplomatic talks to resume negotiations between Russia and Ukraine.

item.title: Senator criticizes AI developers as 'high IQ stupid people'
item.description: The Louisiana Republican's remarks come as both parties seek responses to public backlash against data centers.

item.title: Witkoff and Kushner meet Putin to discuss Ukraine peace
item.description: Trump envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met with Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin on Saturday to discuss U.S. proposals for ending the conflict.

item.title: Energy secretary cautious on gasoline price outlook
item.description: Energy Secretary Chris Wright on Sunday predicted gasoline price relief may be coming but avoided firm commitments or specific timelines.
